title: Text: DET Greg Garno ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: I feel a little bit of pressure on these opening tweets from spring training, not gonna lie
Can’t just sit on my ass for three months and come up with a couple duds
What do you have so far?
Three tweets... my usual “Reporting from Lakeland, where the current temperature is...”
Which I was going to tweet tomorrow on the off day

Then “Good morning from Lakeland, Fla., where the Tigers clubhouse is closed to the media on my first day in spring training. Feels personal.” or “Good morning from Lakeland, Fla., where the Tigers clubhouse is closed to the media on my first day in spring training. No security guards, though.”
And “Tigers general manager Al Avila’s office is closed to the media, too, I’m told” a little while later
